name: @red-cup-engineering/digital-goods-storefront-services-section
description: The house digital-goods storefront: checkout-model, delivery, and receipt semantics usable by every product line (ebooks, newsletters, cohort, merch, briefing). Composes the card rail (stripe-services-section) rather than re-implementing it; catalog validation, view-model shaping, TUFTE storefront presentation, reader accounts (Google sign-in), gifts, stamped review copies and a library per account, paid-release delivery, HMAC download tokens (Web Crypto only, Worker-safe), and plain-JSON receipts.
